@graph.comment: MemTriggerListener — subscribes to MonitoringStore 'changed' events on /vault/wiki/*, runs cross-resource detectors (BoundExceeded, ContradictionDetected, ReflectionDue, UnprocessableWrite), and emits mem:Event activities to /vault/wiki/.events/. v1 attaches the listener + filter pipeline; only the BoundExceeded path is wired (currently a stub). The other three detectors are instantiated for future use. See FOLLOWUPS.md ('Phase C.10 — MemTrigger v1 wiring').

Replace WorkerParallelInitializer handlers with all three listeners. This Override is imported AFTER markdown-projection.json (which sets [Memento, MarkdownProjection]) so its overrideParameters wins. K1: only one Override per instance, hence the consolidation pattern (same as memento.json ↔ markdown-projection.json relationship). All three listeners MUST be listed here because Override semantics replace rather than append.
